title: Sequential Chaining
description: Runs capabilities in order, feeding each output into the next input with type checking at every link. Recorded facts — Pattern: Sequential Chaining; Inputs: ordered capability list; Guarantee: end-to-end correctness. Used by workflow engines, agent frameworks, and service meshes to build reliable multi-step behavior.
demo:
# Sequential Chaining — runnable demo (python3)
# Sequential Chaining - pipeline timing (python3)
stages=[120, 80, 200]
total=sum(stages)
bottleneck=max(stages)
print("total latency: %d ms, bottleneck: %d ms" % (total, bottleneck))
print("bottleneck stage index:", stages.index(bottleneck))
